subject: Hosting commitment runway & region choice — MAP and close timeline
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_k@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@medicushealth.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@procurecloud.io>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-06T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Hosting recommendation & MAP draft — proposed runway and region choices

Hi Elena / Tom —

Following our call this morning, attached is a short MAP + evaluation runway that aligns with Medicus's SLAs and compliance needs. High-level recommendation: start with Dedicated capacity in us-east for pilot traffic (latency-sensitive inference), keep Hosted as a burst/fallback tier, and evaluate a Private (VPC) deployment for EU-regulated workloads if the audit scope requires EU data residency.

Key dates I propose:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP and sign POC SOW
- Week 2–4: pilot (Dedicated us-east) with performance and cost baselines
- Week 6–8: decision point (go/no-go for Dedicated commitment or proceed to Private for EU)

Evaluation criteria (short): latency p50/p95, steady-state tokens/sec, cost per 1M tokens, cold start latencies, KV cache hit rate, and audit evidence checklist (SOC2 Qs).

Please see MAP_Medicus_20260306.pdf (attached) for responsibilities and owners. Main open items for you: confirm whether the EU residency requirement is a hard constraint for PHI/PII or a preference, and whether procurement prefers a single PO for pilot + committed capacity or separate POs.

Next steps: if you confirm residency requirement and PO preference, we can firm up timelines and internal owners.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Head, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_Medicus_20260306.pdf
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@medicushealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_k@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Tom Baker <tom.baker@procurecloud.io>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-08T10:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosting recommendation & MAP draft — proposed runway and region choices

Vivek — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) EU residency: for our EU clinics any PHI that originates in the EU must stay in-region. That is a hard requirement. Some de-identified telemetry can go to us-east.
2) SOC2 evidence: can you provide a subset of logs/audit samples for the Dedicated environment during the pilot? Our security team will want to validate tokenization and access controls.
3) Procurement: we prefer a single PO if we can stage billing — pilot under a separate invoice line item but within one PO. Can Redwood accommodate that?

Also looping Tom from procurement — Tom, is a single PO with staged invoicing workable?

Thanks —
Elena Ortiz
VP Product & Security | Medicus Health
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@medicushealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_k@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T09:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosting recommendation & MAP draft — proposed runway and region choices

Elena, thanks — useful constraints. Narrowing down the MAP to include Private for EU:

Proposed adjustment to MAP (summary):
- Pilot: Dedicated (us-east) for latency-sensitive features where data residency is US-only.
- EU controlled path: provision a Private deployment (VPC) in eu-west-1 for EU-origin PHI. We will run the same evaluation tests there during Weeks 3–6.
- Fallback: Hosted (multi-tenant) remains as fallback for non-PHI, low-latency burst traffic.

Evaluation plan (samples):
- Week 1: Baseline perf tests (p50/p95), cold vs warm starts, KV cache behavior (shared vs per-tenant).
- Week 2: Security review — access controls, KMS integration, sample audit logs. We will provide a SOC2 evidence bundle (stub) during this week — see attached SOC2-evidence-stub.zip.
- Week 3–4: EU Private smoke tests with synthetic EU-origin dataset; capture throughput and latency.
- Week 6: Decision checkpoint and recommended commitment (Dedicated monthly vs Dedicated + Private add-on).

Owners:
- Redwood infra & security lead for the EU Private build: Aditya Rao
- Engagement lead / day-to-day: Camila Reyes

Procurement note: Redwood supports staged invoicing within a single PO — we will send a draft SOW that has line items for pilot + committed capacity. Vivek / Aditya will include pricing tiers for a 3- & 12-month commit.

Elena, can you confirm who on your security team will take the SOC2 bundle and a target date for review (proposed by 2026-03-17)?

Cheers —
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2-evidence-stub.zip
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_k@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-12T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Hosting recommendation & MAP draft — proposed runway and region choices

Internal update (no external recipients on this note):

- Confirmed timeline: target decision checkpoint = 2026-04-17 (Week 6 from pilot start).
- Action items assigned:
  * Aditya: begin Private VPC spec and estimate for eu-west-1 (security hardening & KMS integration) — due 2026-03-18.
  * Camila: finalize MAP SOW with staged invoicing language; include pilot acceptance criteria — due 2026-03-11 (in progress).
  * Vivek: coordinate procurement conversation with Tom; secure signature window for PO by 2026-03-24.

I'll prepare the evaluation checklist doc for the SOC2 handoff and share the Drive link by EOD. Keeping procurement and legal in the loop.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Director, Account Strategy | Redwood Inference
